event_definition: First decoded frame with no visible actor following a visible departure; camera view only, no inferred room crossing.
reviewer: assistant RGB review; not independent human adjudication
population: All 12 home-v1 development and test recordings; no filtering by detector or verifier output. Existing images are not a novel held-out benchmark.

matching.method: maximum one-to-one cardinality, minimum absolute timestamp error, within episode

rule: Target door must be closed at the candidate event timestamp.
baseline: Exact-time stored state if present; otherwise UNKNOWN. No nearest sample or forward fill.
metrics: end-to-end violation recall over all reviewed positive departures
limitations: Fixed single-actor kitchen camera with synthetic render artifacts.
Sparse full-recording contact review plus every native frame near exits; independent dense review remains desirable.
Camera disappearance can represent occlusion or a detection failure.
No claim about all rule operators or real-world transfer.
